title: Brane cluster gases and ghost-free form factors for quantum gravity: verification suite and figure scripts
description:
Verification suite and figure scripts accompanying the manuscript Brane cluster gases and ghost-free form factors for quantum gravity by Deep Bhattacharjee, prepared for Physical Review D.

The suite checks_clusters.py runs 171 independent checks in eleven groups: the nerve complex and its Euler identity, intersection numbers on the torus, the subset-sum and Poisson generating functions, the Barnes-Rivers projector algebra, the residue sum rule and the pole dichotomy, the superficial degree of divergence, the Euclidean propagator of the Gaussian form factor in D = 3, 4, 5, 6, the Newtonian potential and the weak-field threshold, the on-shell dispersion relation, the Schwinger parametric representation with its spanning-tree bound and the closed-form one-loop bubble, and the composition of transmission amplitudes against the exact transfer matrix. No check uses a formula proved in the paper as an input. The eight figure scripts regenerate every figure at 600 dpi and run a label collision test before saving.
